description.narrative: L'iniziativa contribuirà alla risposta alla siccità in corso in Etiopia. Nell'ambito di questo programma saranno finanziati interventi multisettoriali attuati da ONG selezionate nelle regioni più colpite, Oromia, SNNP, Sud-Ovest, Sidama e Somalia. I progetti si concentreranno sui servizi di base, sulla protezione e sugli interventi salvavita per le popolazioni colpite. Inoltre, l'obiettivo finale è quello di migliorare la qualità dei servizi WaSH e l'accesso alle infrastrutture e ai servizi idrici per il consumo umano e animale e per l'uso in agricoltura, nonché di sostenere la riabilitazione o la costruzione di servizi e infrastrutture di base anche per i campi per sfollati interni. Il risultato prioritario dell'iniziativa è il miglioramento dell'accesso ai servizi sanitari di base, con particolare attenzione al miglioramento dei servizi sanitari in termini di salute materna, infantile, sessuale e riproduttiva, alla malnutrizione e alle principali cause di morbilità identificate; il rafforzamento dei servizi sanitari di emergenza; i servizi di risposta per i casi di SAM e MAM supportati.

The Initiative will contribute to the response to the ongoing drought in Ethiopia. In the framework of this programme will be funded multisectorial interventions implemented by selected NGOs in the most affected regions, Oromia, SNNP, South West, Sidama and Somali. The projects will focus on basic services, protection and life-saving interventions for affected populations. Moreover, The ultimate goal is to improve the quality of WaSH services and access to water infrastructure and services for human and animal consumption and use in agriculture as well as supporting the rehabilitation or construction of basic services and infrastructure also for IDP camps.The priority result of the initiative is the improvement of access to basic health services, with particular attention to improving health services in terms of maternal, child, sexual and reproductive health, malnutrition and the main identified causes of morbidity; strengthened emergency health services; response services for SAM and MAM cases supported

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
By 2030, achieve universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water for all

By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

By 2030, end preventable deaths of newborns and children under 5 years of age, with all countries aiming to reduce neonatal mortality to at least as low as 12 per 1,000 live births and under-5 mortality to at least as low as 25 per 1,000 live births
By 2030, reduce the global maternal mortality ratio to less than 70 per 100,000 live births
Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation
End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
